note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; both the soldier and the worker are given with characters and measurements, the alate is absent; the specific epithet is OCR’d as “pusiilus” and should be pusillus; synonymy, figure numbers, localities and the records of Termitaria parasites are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval to subrectangular, the sides slightly rounded, densely covered with rather long setae; antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 as long as segment 4, segment 2 longer; labrum more than half as long as the mandibles; fontanelle indistinct; anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly notched. Measurements (mm): head length 1.27–1.29, head width 0.63–0.67, pronotal length 0.28, width 0.42, hind tibia length 0.51, left mandible length 0.50.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 showing traces of division; head width 0.72–0.78 mm, hind tibia length 0.44 mm.
